page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, with Hebrew and Greek words. At the top left the page number, centred the Hebrew running head. Below the text a rule, then a large Hebrew section letter and the entry "ראה". No marginal notes.

main_text.p: genti inquisitione. Imperat. התקששו [?] וקשו [?] Excutite vos ipsos, iterumq; excutite, Soph.2.1. Pih. Praeterit. ויקששו [?] להם [?] Et conquirant sibi stramen, Exod.5. v.7. Particip. מקששים [?] עצים [?] Conquirentem sive colligentem lignia, Num.15. v.32. Foemin. מקששת [?] Conquirens, 1.Reg.17.10. Infinit. לקשש קש [?] Ad conquirendum stipulam, Exod.5.12. Hithp. Imper. ante in Kal.

קשת c. fed f. sapius, Arcus: קשת Arcus Jonathanis לא נשוב [?] non recedit retrorsum, 2.Sam.1.22. ubi masculinum: Vide & 2.Sam.22.35. קשת דרוכה Arcus adductus vel intentus, Jesa.21.15. Affix. קשתי Arcum meum dabo in nubibus, Genes.9.13. Plural. וקשתות [?] Et arcus, Jesa.13.18. Aff. וקשתותם [?] Et arcus eorum confringentur, Psalm.37.15.
קשת m. Sagittarius, Arcitenens: קשת רבה [?] Jaculator arcitenens, id est, Sagittarius, Gen.21.20.

קיתרוס m. Chald. Cithara, Dan.3. v.5. Scribitur cum ', quasi legendum fuisset קיתרוס κιθάρα, sed juxta Masorethas & Hebraeos legitur absque Joth, קתרוס. R.Saadias explicat per Hebraum כנור. Jonathan eo semel usus in Targum, קתרוס ואבוב [?] Cum cithara & organo, Jes.5.12. pro Hebraeo תוף. Falsi sunt, qui putant pro Hebraeo כנור in Targum usurpari.
ראה Vidit, Invisit : Praevidit, Providit : Aspexit, Inspexit, Prospexit, Perspexit, Respexit, Circumspexit : Est & animi & aliorum sensuum, Experiri, Animadvertere, Percipere, Frui. Construi-

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek readings are uncertain at many points in the small, heavy print; those words are marked [?]. "Jefa" and "Genef" are printed with long s and read as Jesa and Genes. "lignia" may be "ligna"; kept as printed with the doubt noted. The rule under the text and the Google watermark at the lower right are not transcribed. Catchword "tur" completes the hyphenated "Construi-".
